recent_videos.description:
Can you experience the thrill of Rafting in Rishikesh for just ₹400? In this video, we share our real river rafting experience during our budget trip to Rishikesh.

We planned a budget-friendly trip to Rishikesh, but there was one adventure we simply couldn't miss: Rafting in Rishikesh, one of the most popular adventure activities in India.

I was travelling with my friend Sofiyan, and things got interesting even before the adventure began. We had forgotten to bring our shorts and T-shirts, so we had to buy them from a nearby shop before heading out for rafting.

We purchased our rafting tickets for approximately ₹400 per person and joined seven other people in our rafting boat. Before entering the river, our guide explained everything we needed to know, including how to paddle forward, reverse, stop, and navigate the rapid waves.

Then the real adventure began.

We covered approximately 12 kilometres of river rafting, surrounded by the beautiful natural scenery of Rishikesh. Every rapid brought a new thrill, and every moment became a memory worth keeping.

For safety reasons, our mobile phones and other electronic devices were packed away before the rafting started. Our guide captured the adventure using a GoPro, and we paid an additional ₹300 for the photos and videos.

Honestly, this was one of the most memorable experiences of our trip. If you're planning a budget trip to Rishikesh, river rafting is an adventure worth considering.

Rafting in Rishikesh Price Breakdown:

Rafting ticket: Approximately ₹400 per person
GoPro photos and videos: ₹300 extra
Shorts and T-shirts: Additional cost

These are our personal trip expenses. Actual prices may vary depending on the rafting operator, season, route, and package. Always confirm the total cost and safety arrangements before booking.

Is Rafting in Rishikesh Worth It?

recent_videos.description:
Join us on an incredible journey through Dhanushkodi, Rameshwaram and the iconic Pamban Bridge in Tamil Nadu. 🇮🇳🌊

In this Dhanushkodi Rameshwaram travel experience, we explore one of the most fascinating destinations in South India. Dhanushkodi is famous for its beautiful coastline, Dhanushkodi Beach, mysterious abandoned structures and fascinating Dhanushkodi history. Once a thriving town, Dhanushkodi was devastated by a cyclone in 1964 and is now popularly known as one of India's mysterious ghost towns.

Our journey continues through Rameshwaram, one of the most important pilgrimage and historical destinations in Tamil Nadu. If you're planning Rameshwaram travel or looking for places to visit in Rameshwaram, this destination offers a unique combination of spirituality, history, beaches and incredible landscapes.

We also visit the famous Pamban Bridge in Rameshwaram, an iconic landmark connecting Rameshwaram Island with mainland India. The historic Pamban railway bridge and the surrounding ocean views make this one of the most memorable experiences on a Tamil Nadu travel journey.

The region around Dhanushkodi is also closely associated with the legendary Ram Setu, also known as Adam's Bridge, making it an important destination for both history and mythology. From Dhanushkodi Beach and Rameshwaram to Pamban Bridge, this journey showcases some of the most beautiful and historical places in Tamil Nadu.

recent_videos.description:
Planning a Sri Lanka trip? Stop — there are 4 things you need to know first.

Sri Lanka costs about the same as a Goa or Kerala trip, and Chennai to
Colombo is a flight of just 1 hour 20 minutes. It is the cheapest and
closest international trip you can take from India.

This video covers everything you need before you book — the right season,
the real cost, Sri Lanka's old connection with India, and the four
completely different ways to travel the island.

The biggest mistake people make is going to the wrong coast in the wrong
month. Sri Lanka has two separate monsoons running at opposite times of
year. So there is no bad time to visit Sri Lanka — only a wrong coast.


📍 WHAT'S COVERED
- South West vs North East — the right season for each coast
- South West Monsoon (May–Sep) and North East Monsoon (Nov–Mar)
- A realistic budget breakdown for the whole trip
- Sri Lanka's 8 UNESCO World Heritage Sites
- Cultural Circuit, Ramayana Trail, Wildlife and Beach circuits
- Chennai → Colombo — 686 km, 1 hour 20 minutes
- Full route: Colombo, Kandy, Sigiriya, Dambulla, Nuwara Eliya,
  Ella, Yala, Mirissa and Galle

🇱🇰 SRI LANKA — QUICK FACTS
- Length: 433 km (Point Pedro to Dondra Head)
- Width: 225 km at its widest point
- Area: 65,610 km²
- 8 UNESCO World Heritage Sites — 6 cultural, 2 natural
- Two monsoons, so one coast is always in season

Shalimar Garden/Shalimar Bagh - One of the most beautiful Mughal garden of Kashmir

Lal Chowk – discovering the heart of the city and the area which used to be very sensitive

🥾 Planning the Annapurna Base Camp Trek? 🇳🇵🏔️
Don’t make these 5 BIG mistakes!

These mistakes can make your ABC Trek harder, more stressful, and more expensive. 💸

• 01 | Carry enough Nepali cash 💰
Carry sufficient Nepali currency (NPR) because Indian currency may not work everywhere, and UPI is not available at every location in the mountains.

• 02 | Get your permits sorted beforehand 📄
Make sure you have all the required ABC Trek permits and documents before starting your trek to avoid getting stopped on the route.

• 03 | Stay hydrated 💧
Always carry drinking water. If you refill from natural water streams, use water purification tablets before drinking.

• 04 | Don’t overpack 🎒
Avoid unnecessary items. The heavier your backpack, the harder your trek will be!

• 05 | Carry protein & energy bars ⚡
Some trekking sections have shops far apart, so keep protein bars, energy bars and quick snacks for an instant energy boost.
